record.part_note: Bosch Sensortec BMI088 6-axis IMU — the HAT's DORMANT second IMU: research/raw/deploy_audio_i2c3-pihat.dts lists it at I2C 0x19 (accelerometer) / 0x68 (gyroscope), 'unused but still connected' (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §4.2). Everything here was read off datasheet.pdf IN THIS FOLDER, fetched 2026-09-02 from Bosch Sensortec's own server.
record.description: p.2 verbatim: 'BMI088 is an inertial measurement unit (IMU) for the detection of movements and rotations in 6 degrees of freedom (6DoF). It combines the functionality of two inertial sensors in one device: an advanced triaxial 16-bit gyroscope and a versatile, leading-edge triaxial 16-bit accelerometer.' 'are packed into one single LGA 3.0mm x 4.5mm x 0.95mm housing.'
record.datasheet_rev: p.1 verbatim: 'BMI088: Data Sheet | Document revision 1.9 | Document release date January 2024 | Document number BST-BMI088-DS000-19 | Technical reference code 0 273 141 365'. NOTE the URL says ds001 while the document numbers itself DS000-19 — recorded, not resolved. 62 pages. Every page footer: 'Document number: BST-BMI088-DS000-19', 'Revision_1.9_012024'. HTTP 200, 1368590 bytes, fetched 2026-09-02.
record.identity_vs_fitted: The overlay names the chip and two addresses that exist only in this device's address table (0x19 accel with SDO1 high, 0x68 gyro with SDO2 low — p.48). A BMI088 has one package, so the package axis cannot be wrong. Whether the production HAT still carries it: CANNOT DETERMINE.
record.package: p.2: 'LGA 3.0mm x 4.5mm x 0.95mm'. §8 Package, p.54: 'The sensor housing is a standard LGA package.'
record.absolute_max: Table 7: Absolute maximum ratings, p.12, verbatim: 'Voltage at Supply Pin | VDD Pin | -0.3 | 4 | V'; 'VDDIO Pin | -0.3 | 4 | V'; 'Voltage at any Logic Pin | Non-Supply Pin | -0.3 | VDDIO+0.3 | V'; 'ESD | HBM, at any Pin | 2 kV'.

supplies.name: VDD
supplies.cite: Table 1: Electrical parameter specification, p.7: 'Supply Voltage | VDD | Internal Domains | 2.4 | 3.6 | V'. No typical column in the table — v_typ null by observation.

supplies.name: VDDIO
supplies.cite: Table 1, p.7: 'Supply Voltage | VDDIO | I/O Domain | 1.2 | 3.6 | V'. §2.x p.14: 'VDDIO is a separate power supply pin mainly used for the supply of the interface'.

current_mA.typical_basis: DERIVED SUM, NOT PRINTED: gyro 5 mA + accel 0.15 mA. Table 3 p.8: 'Supply Current in Normal Mode | IDD | VDD = VDDIO = 3.0V, 25°C, ODR =1kHz | 5 | mA' (gyroscope); Table 2 p.8: 'Total Supply Current in Normal mode | IDD | VDD = VDDIO =3.0V, 25°C, gFS4g | 150 | µA' (accelerometer). The sheet never totals the two.
current_mA.sleep_basis: DERIVED SUM: gyro suspend 25 µA (Table 3) + accel suspend 3 µA (Table 2) = 28 µA. Gyro deep suspend is '<5' µA.
current_mA.peak_basis: NOT TRANSCRIBED HERE. No peak figure was read out of the document this block cites (see `cite`) when this record was written, and none is asserted now (basis added 2026-09-02, wiring lane, so cecad.electrical's loader can read the shelf: a null with no reason is refused). Null means not looked up in this record — NOT zero. Re-read the sheet's current-consumption table to fill it.

logic.cite: Table 1 p.7: 'Voltage Input Low Level | VIL,a | SPI & I²C | 0.3VDDIO'; 'Voltage Input High Level | VIH,a | SPI & I²C | 0.7VDDIO'. Ratiometric to VDDIO (1.2–3.6 V), so a 3.3 V bus is fine with VDDIO = 3.3 V — the HAT's VDDIO rail is CANNOT DETERMINE.

record.interface: I2C or SPI (PS pin selects; p.44 'PS = ´VDDIO´ selects I²C')
record.i2c_address: §6.2 Inter-Integrated Circuit (I²C), p.48, verbatim: 'The default I²C addresses are: Accelerometer: SDO1 pin pulled to ‘GND’: 0011000b (0x18) / SDO1 pin pulled to ‘VDDIO’: 0011001b (0x19) / Gyroscope: SDO2 pin pulled to ‘GND’: 1101000b (0x68) / SDO2 pin pulled to ‘VDDIO’: 1101001b (0x69)'. 'The I²C interface of the BMI088 is compatible with the I²C Specification UM10204 Rev. 03 (19 June 2007)'; 'supports I²C standard mode and fast mode, only 7-bit address mode is supported.' The overlay's 0x19 / 0x68 therefore means SDO1 = VDDIO and SDO2 = GND on the HAT — INFERRED from this table, not read off a schematic.
record.ranges: Table 4: Accelerometer specifications, p.9: 'Acceleration Range | gFS3g ±3 | gFS6g ±6 | gFS12g ±12 | gFS24g ±24 | g'; 'Output Data Rate | ODR | 12.5 | 1600 | Hz'. Gyroscope range table p.39: '0x00 | ±2000 | 16.384 LSB/°/s'.
unknowns: Whether the production Microduck head IMU IS this BMI088 or another part, and whether any shipped code reads it — docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §4.2 open question 3. `i2cdetect -y 3` on a production HAT settles it.
The HAT's VDD / VDDIO rails for this part: CANNOT DETERMINE.
The two typical current figures are sums of separate tables; the sheet never prints a combined number and gives no inrush figure.

Interface max clock: the I²C timing table (table 13, p.48ff) was not transcribed here; the sheet says 'standard mode and fast mode' (≤ 400 kHz by the I²C spec it cites, UM10204 — that ceiling is the spec's, not a number printed on p.48).
